name: privatools_list_tools
description: Search and filter PrivaTools /api/v1 operations by keyword query, category, or mode (sync/async). Uses the live /api/v1 catalog (or OpenAPI spec) with an automatic offline fallback.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Optional keyword search across operation slugs, tool aliases, summaries, and categories.

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Optional case-insensitive category filter.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: Filter by execution mode: all, sync, or async.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum operations to return (1-250, default 50).

arguments.name: offset
arguments.desc: Pagination offset (default 0).

name: privatools_describe_tool
description: Inspect the exact endpoint, HTTP method, accepted file upload fields, form/query parameters, constraints, cost, async support, and response media types for a PrivaTools operation slug or alias.

arguments.name: operation
arguments.desc: Operation slug, path, or tool alias (e.g. 'compress', 'accessibility-check').

name: privatools_run_tool
description: Execute any synchronous PrivaTools /api/v1/<operation> tool against local file(s) and parameters. Binary outputs are written directly to disk without overwriting unless overwrite is true; JSON tools return JSON inline. Parameter and upload field details for each operation are available from privatools_describe_tool.

arguments.name: operation
arguments.desc: Operation slug, path, or tool alias.

arguments.name: file_path
arguments.desc: Local path to a single input file.

arguments.name: file_paths
arguments.desc: Local paths to multiple input files, in order.

arguments.name: file_field
arguments.desc: Optional multipart upload field name override.

arguments.name: file_fields
arguments.desc: Optional map of multipart field names to file path(s).

arguments.name: params
arguments.desc: Optional operation parameters (form, JSON, or query fields).

arguments.name: output_path
arguments.desc: Optional destination path for binary output.

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Allow replacing an existing file at output_path (default false).

name: privatools_submit_job
description: Submit an asynchronous background job (POST /api/v1/jobs) for supported heavy/large operations such as 'merge', 'compress', 'grayscale', or 'pdf-to-text'.

arguments.name: operation
arguments.desc: Async operation slug.

arguments.name: file_path
arguments.desc: Local path to a single PDF input file.

arguments.name: file_paths
arguments.desc: Local paths to multiple PDF input files, in order.

arguments.name: options
arguments.desc: Optional operation-specific options object.

arguments.name: idempotency_key
arguments.desc: Optional Idempotency-Key for safe retries.

name: privatools_job_status
description: Strictly read-only tool to poll an asynchronous job's status (action: 'status') or download its completed artifact to output_path (action: 'download'). Does not delete or mutate server-side jobs.

arguments.name: job_id
arguments.desc: Job ID returned by privatools_submit_job.

arguments.name: action
arguments.desc: Read-only action to perform: status or download.

arguments.name: output_path
arguments.desc: Destination file path when downloading a binary artifact.

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Allow replacing an existing file at output_path (default false).

arguments.name: download
arguments.desc: Automatically download when action is status and job succeeded.

name: privatools_delete_job
description: Permanently delete a completed server-side async job artifact or cancel a running asynchronous job (destructiveHint: true).

arguments.name: job_id
arguments.desc: Job ID returned by privatools_submit_job to delete or cancel.
